dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが始めますか？
dialogue.English: It's a bit early, but shall we begin?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, let's.

dialogue.content: では、お願いします
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい、宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 両親のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm worried about my parents.

dialogue.content: それは大事なことですよね
dialogue.English: That's an important matter, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どの様なご状況なのですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about your situation?

dialogue.content: 私は既婚者で自分の両親は80代半ばになります
dialogue.English: I'm married, and my parents are in their mid-80s.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 別居です。両親はまだ認知症などにはなっていないのですが、、
dialogue.English: We live separately. My parents haven't been diagnosed with dementia or anything yet, but...

dialogue.content: ご高齢で別居なされていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: They're elderly and living separately from you, right?

dialogue.content: はい。最近、ひがみっぽかったり何度も同じことを言い聞かされたりで嫌になります
dialogue.English: Yes. Lately, they've become resentful and repeat the same things over and over, and it's starting to bother me.

dialogue.content: 高齢なので気になり、１週間に1度くらいは顔を出すのですが、
dialogue.English: I worry about them because they're elderly, so I drop by about once a week, but...

dialogue.content: 認知症と診断されていなくとも親御さんの対応にお疲れなのですね
dialogue.English: So even without a dementia diagnosis, dealing with your parents is tiring you out, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。憂鬱な気分になるのであまり行きたくなくなります。
dialogue.English: Yes. It makes me feel depressed, so I don't really want to go anymore.

dialogue.content: 週に1度とはいえ辛くしんどいおもいですよね
dialogue.English: Even if it's only once a week, that must feel painful and difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親御さんのどちらが、ひがみっぽい状態なのですか？
dialogue.English: Which of your parents tends to be more resentful?

dialogue.content: 主に母の方です
dialogue.English: It's mainly my mother.

dialogue.content: お母さまが特にひどい感じなのですね
dialogue.English: So it's particularly pronounced with your mother.

dialogue.content: お父様はいかがでしょう？
dialogue.English: And how about your father?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 父は頑固でくどい性格です
dialogue.English: My father is stubborn and long-winded.

dialogue.content: 何度も同じ事を言います
dialogue.English: He says the same things over and over.

dialogue.content: あー！ご両親とも問題を感じてらっしゃるのはお辛いですね
dialogue.English: Oh, it must be so difficult for you to feel you're having issues with both of your parents.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 週に1度、ご実家にいかれるのはお一人ですか？
dialogue.English: When you go to your parents' house once a week, do you go alone?

dialogue.content: はいそうです。前は親に身近な悩みを相談することもありましたが
dialogue.English: Yes. I used to talk to my parents about my personal worries, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今はそんなことも出来ないので重荷なだけです
dialogue.English: But I can't do that anymore, so it just feels like a burden.

dialogue.content: 高齢なので
dialogue.English: Because they're elderly.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね以前はご相談もされるよな仲だったのに・・・
dialogue.English: I see. So you used to have the kind of relationship where you could confide in them...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はこちらが何かしてあげなければと言う感じです
dialogue.English: Now it feels like I'm the one who has to do things for them.

dialogue.content: ええ高齢とはいえ親の老いていく変化を受け入れるのは難しいことですよね
dialogue.English: Yes. Even knowing they're elderly, it's hard to accept the changes that come with your parents aging.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 不安もあります
dialogue.English: I feel anxious about it too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね寂しさも不安も複雑な思いでいっぱいでしょうね
dialogue.English: I understand. You must be filled with complex feelings, like loneliness and anxiety.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: ご両親の身近には他に様子を見に行ってくれる方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone else nearby who can check in on your parents?

dialogue.content: 兄がたまに顔を出しているようです
dialogue.English: My older brother seems to drop by occasionally.

dialogue.content: お兄さまとはご両親について何かお話しされてますか？
dialogue.English: Do you and your brother talk about your parents at all?

dialogue.content: ラインでたまにやりとりする程度であまりコミニュケーション出来ていません
dialogue.English: We exchange messages on LINE occasionally, but we don't communicate much.

dialogue.content: お二人で協力しながらの親御さんの面倒をみる体制ではないのですね
dialogue.English: So the two of you don't really have a cooperative setup for caring for your parents.

dialogue.content: そう言われればそうかも知れません
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it, that might be true.

dialogue.content: それなりに、2人とも自分のペースで気にはしているつもりです
dialogue.English: I mean, we both try to be mindful of them in our own way, at our own pace.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは自発的に週に1度ご心配で様子見にいかれてたのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been voluntarily visiting them about once a week out of concern.

dialogue.content: はい、頭のリハビリと思って簡単な仕事を父に頼んでいるし
dialogue.English: Yes, and I ask my father to do simple tasks as mental exercise.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 必ず週一とはいかないんですが最低でも月に一度は必ず行きます
dialogue.English: I can't always manage once a week, but I go at least once a month without fail.

dialogue.content: 気が重いながらも、お会いになれば工夫しながらの接し方をされてきたと。がんばっていらっしゃいますね
dialogue.English: So even though you find it draining, when you do see them, you've been making an effort to interact with them in thoughtful ways. You're trying very hard.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Thank you.

dialogue.content: 気が重く、同じ話の繰り返しは耐え難いものです義務感だけではつとまりませんよね
dialogue.English: It's draining, and hearing the same stories over and over is hard to bear. You couldn't do it out of a sense of duty alone.

dialogue.content: そうかも知れません
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: でも、相談者さんが一人で抱え込まずいれた事は幸いだったかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Still, it's perhaps fortunate that you don't have to carry this burden entirely on your own.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: ラインでしかコンタクトしないお兄さんですがご兄弟の仲はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you only contact your brother through LINE; what is your relationship with him like?

dialogue.content: 悪くはないですが疎遠です。
dialogue.English: It's not bad, but we're distant.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: お嫁さんも居るので兄が気を使っているのかも知れません
dialogue.English: He has a wife, so maybe my brother is being considerate of her.

dialogue.content: 親御さんにはお兄さんも何となく行ってるな。の感じしか把握できていないのですね
dialogue.English: So you only have a vague sense that your brother is visiting your parents from time to time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 兄の家は両親の住む家には少し距離があるので
dialogue.English: My brother's house is a bit far from where our parents live.

dialogue.content: 私の方が20分で行けますから
dialogue.English: Whereas I can get there in 20 minutes.

dialogue.content: 余計に私に精神的な負担がのしかかってきます
dialogue.English: So more of the emotional burden falls on me.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまのほうが距離的に近いのでお兄さまに気を使われてる事も精神的に大きいのでしょかね
dialogue.English: Since you're closer, does the need to be considerate of your brother also add to your emotional strain?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは、妹さん？弟さん？どちらにあたるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you the younger sister or the younger brother?

dialogue.content: 妹です
dialogue.English: I'm his younger sister.

dialogue.content: 娘さんだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're the daughter.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでは女性ならではの気の使いようや将来へのご不安も強かったでしょうね
dialogue.English: In that case, you've probably felt a stronger sense of anxiety about the future and pressure to be considerate, in ways often expected of a daughter.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: 兄は経済的にあまり力が無くて
dialogue.English: My brother is not very well-off financially.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・ご両親の事をご主人さまは何かおっしゃっておらてますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Does your husband say anything about your parents?

dialogue.content: たまに、言葉では気にしてくれることもありますが、ほぼ無関心です
dialogue.English: Sometimes he expresses concern in words, but for the most part, he's indifferent.

dialogue.content: それはお辛い・・・一人で抱えてるも同然でしたね
dialogue.English: That must be difficult... It's as if you've been carrying this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: そうなりますかね…
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: 少しお話しをまとめさせて頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お兄さまはいらっしゃるものの、ほぼお一人でご両親の将来や現状況を気になされ
dialogue.English: Although you have a brother, you are mostly the one concerned about your parents' current situation and their future,

dialogue.content: 経時的にも精神的にも抱え込み、ご自身なりの工夫はしているものの先の事が不安になっている。と言う感じでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: carrying the burden both emotionally and in terms of your time. And while you are trying your best to cope, you feel anxious about what's to come. Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: はいそういう感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's about it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます一番理解して欲しいと感じるとしたら誰でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. If you could have one person understand how you feel, who would it be?

dialogue.content: この気持ちをですか？
dialogue.English: How I feel about this?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: というか、分け合いたいみたいな
dialogue.English: Or rather, who you'd want to share this burden with.

dialogue.content: 兄です
dialogue.English: My brother.

dialogue.content: 2人の親ですから
dialogue.English: They're his parents too.

dialogue.content: そうですね現実的にもお兄さんと話し合っていければ多少でも気持ちも楽になりそうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, practically speaking, discussing it with your brother could lighten your emotional load a bit.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: たったお二人の兄妹、共感できることはありそうな気はしますが・・・
dialogue.English: You are the only two siblings. I feel like there must be things you could relate to each other about...

dialogue.content: そこまでの過程をどうしていくかですよね
dialogue.English: The question is how to get to that point, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 多分、会えば話しは普通に出来るので
dialogue.English: I think if we met in person, we could talk normally.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、お互いのタイミングで親御さんに会いに行かれてるとおっしゃっておらてましたが
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you both visit your parents whenever you have time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 深い会話なしに自然に出来ていた事なのですね
dialogue.English: So that's something you've been able to do naturally without having any deep conversations about it.

dialogue.content: はい、兄の仕事は休みが不定期なので週末に足を運ぶ私とはあまりバッティングしないだけです
dialogue.English: Yes, my brother's work schedule is irregular, so he rarely happens to be there at the same time as me, since I usually go on weekends.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・スケジュールが分かっていた事だったのですね
dialogue.English: I see... so you were aware of each other's schedules.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あうんの呼吸かと思ってしまいました
dialogue.English: I thought it might have been unspoken coordination.

dialogue.content: お会いになれば
dialogue.English: If you were to meet,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普通に会話が出来るとおしゃっておられましたが今の気持ちや、今後のことなど話せる機会を設けられることはできそうですか？
dialogue.English: you said you could talk normally. Do you think you could create an opportunity to talk about how you're feeling now and about the future?

dialogue.content: 何か事がおこれば話し合いは出来るかと思います
dialogue.English: I think we could discuss things if something were to happen.

dialogue.content: 何かがおこれば。なかんじですか・・・
dialogue.English: "If something were to happen"... is that how it feels?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今の私の気持ちは誰かに分かって欲しいというより
dialogue.English: Right now, my feelings are less about wanting someone to understand me and more...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 少し違う気がするので
dialogue.English: ...I feel like it's something a little different.

dialogue.content: 伝え方が悪かったです
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I phrased that poorly.

dialogue.content: 自分の両親への感情が悲しいんです。重荷に感じる自分が嫌いなのかも知れません
dialogue.English: I'm sad about my own feelings toward my parents. Maybe I hate myself for feeling that they are a burden.

dialogue.content: 自分にも確実に老いが来るのに
dialogue.English: Even though I know for sure that I'll get old too.

dialogue.content: 優しい気持ちになれない自分が嫌なんです
dialogue.English: I hate that I can't feel more compassionate.

dialogue.content: ご自分をお責めになられる気持ちがお強かったのですね
dialogue.English: You're being very hard on yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私自身の将来を見ているようで
dialogue.English: It's like I'm looking at my own future.

dialogue.content: それだけのご負担を抱えながら優しい気持ちになるのはご無理かとおもいます
dialogue.English: With such a heavy burden, I think it would be impossible to feel compassionate.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: 長く生きるとそうやって子供からも重荷に感じられると思うと
dialogue.English: When I think that if I live a long time, my own children will feel I'm a burden in the same way...

dialogue.content: 憂鬱です
dialogue.English: ...it's depressing.

dialogue.content: 次は我が身。とも感じてしまわれるのですねどこかで、なにかで、ご自身のリセットできる時間は必要ですよね
dialogue.English: You feel like it's your turn next, don't you? You need time to reset yourself, somewhere, somehow.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 優しいお気持ちがあありになるからのお悩みだとも思います
dialogue.English: I also think you're struggling with this precisely because you have a kind heart.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Thank you.

dialogue.content: 自分勝手かと思っていました
dialogue.English: I thought I was just being selfish.

dialogue.content: 悩み相談してくれてた優しいご両親が、ご高齢で変化していき
dialogue.English: Your kind parents, whom you used to confide in, are changing as they grow older,

dialogue.content: ご兄弟がいながらもお一人でご不安や工夫など考え
dialogue.English: and though you have a sibling, you're alone in your anxiety, trying to figure out how to handle things,

dialogue.content: 親御さんを見れば見るほど今度は、ご自身と重ね合わせ
dialogue.English: and the more you look at your parents, the more you see your own future in them,

dialogue.content: 自然の摂理といっても簡単に受け入れられる事柄ではありませんよね
dialogue.English: Even if it's the natural course of life, it's not something that's easy to accept, is it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, it's not.

dialogue.content: 辛いです
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: 悲しいんです
dialogue.English: I'm sad.

dialogue.content: 優しくない人はそんなに悩まず、悲しくもなく辛くもないですよ
dialogue.English: Someone who wasn't kind wouldn't worry so much, or feel so sad and pained by this.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: なんだか泣けてきます
dialogue.English: I feel like crying.

dialogue.content: もっと現実的にご自身が頑張っていらっしゃることに目をむけてみてあげてください
dialogue.English: Please try to look at the reality of how hard you're trying.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 自分はダメな人かと思っていたので
dialogue.English: I thought I was a bad person.

dialogue.content: 充分に頑張って、工夫して考えてる素敵な娘さんだとお話しをお聞きして思っております
dialogue.English: From listening to you, I think you're a wonderful daughter who is trying her best, thinking and finding ways to manage.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 重荷に感じていてもいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay for me to feel that they're a burden?

dialogue.content: 辛いものは辛いです！！しんどーい！と言葉にだしてみてもいいですよね
dialogue.English: If something is painful, it's painful! It's okay to say out loud, "This is so hard!"

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 閉じこめなくてもいいんですね？
dialogue.English: So I don't have to keep it bottled up?

dialogue.content: 親御さんを大切にすると同時にそれ以上ご自身の気持ちを大事にしてあげて欲しいと願います
dialogue.English: While you care for your parents, I hope you will care for your own feelings even more.

dialogue.content: 閉じ込めず逆に開放してあげて欲しいです
dialogue.English: Instead of bottling them up, I hope you'll release them.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。そう言っていただけて救われる思いがします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. Hearing you say that feels like a weight has been lifted.

dialogue.content: はい、ご自身を大事にしてください
dialogue.English: Yes, please take care of yourself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: やってみます
dialogue.English: I'll try.

dialogue.content: (ちょっと半端になりましたが時間だいぶ過ぎましたので終了で大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.English: (This feels a bit unfinished, but we're quite over time. Is it okay if we wrap up?)

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: (終結までもう少しでしたが長くなって申し訳なかったです。ありがとうごっざいました)
dialogue.English: (We were close to wrapping up, but it went long; I'm sorry. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！とても素敵なカウンセリングをいただきました。
dialogue.English: Thank you so much! That was a wonderful counseling session.

dialogue.content: (又、お会いすることがありましたらよろしくお願いいたします。今日はありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (If we have the chance to meet again, I look forward to it. Thank you for today.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、とても勉強になりありがたかったです！！
dialogue.English: Likewise, this was a great learning experience for me. Thank you!

dialogue.content: こちらこそまた宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to working with you again.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。では、終了ボタンクリックしますね＾＾
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm going to click the end button now. ^^

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では、また＾＾
dialogue.English: See you again. ^^
